review.headline: Long run 17 km completed on target: steady 5:50/km, HR 143, inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy band.
observations: Distance 17.02 km against 17.0 planned, with every km split at 5:50/km, so pacing was very even.
Average HR 143 (max 146) sits comfortably in the easy range, with no drift across the 17 splits.
Pace is near the slow end of the easy band, which fits the instruction to stay unhurried.
Elevation gain 113 m is modest and did not disturb the steady effort.
flags: RPE was not logged (0), so the athlete's perceived effort is unknown.
No fueling notes were recorded, so race-day fueling practice is unverified.
Week 2 session on 2026-11-10 was cut short at 6 km with heavy legs and RPE 8, which is a recent fatigue marker.
